title: Informer: Beyond Efficient Transformer for Long Sequence Time-Series Forecasting
grouping: Two blue dotted rounded containers titled 'Encoder' and 'Decoder', side by side; a purple dotted bracket labelled 'Concatenated Feature Map' caps the encoder, and one wire runs from it over to the decoder's cross-attention box. A pale purple 'Fully Connected Layer' bar sits above the decoder, outside its container.
shapes_depth: Attention layers are drawn as white trapezoids narrowing upward (stacked, separated by thin light-blue bars), with a smaller second trapezoid stack beside the first as a reduced replica. Inputs are token rows of tall cells under each container: the encoder row has green-filled upper halves; the decoder row has green cells for the start tokens and then cells printed with '0' for the horizon. The output is a row of white cells whose right part is filled yellow. Serif labels; the input sets are given as math (X_en, X_de = {X_token, X_0}).
proposed_highlight: The proposed attention is named inside the trapezoids ('ProbSparse'); the narrowing trapezoid itself depicts distilling. The forecast is emphasised by the yellow output cells that line up with the zero placeholders in the decoder input.
lesson: Draw the decoder input as a token row of filled start tokens followed by cells marked 0 for the horizon, and fill only the matching output cells, so start-token-plus-placeholder generative decoding is read from the cells.
notes: Venue from Semantic Scholar (title match: AAAI); the AAAI 2021 year is remembered but not confirmed, so year = arXiv preprint year (2012.07436).

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

insights.structure: Two blue dashed rounded frames side by side, Encoder on the left and Decoder on the right, with a purple dashed 'Concatenated Feature Map' tab on the encoder and a Fully Connected Layer plus output row above the decoder.
insights.data: Inputs are two-row cell strips at the bottom (X_en, and X_de = {X_token, X_0} whose right half is filled with zeros); outputs are a cell row whose predicted cells are yellow.
insights.emphasis: Encoder self-attention layers are drawn as narrowing trapezoids stacked (plus a smaller side replica) to show the distilling halving, and the zero-padded decoder input marks the generative one-shot decoding.
insights.flow: Bottom to top within each frame; one line leaves the encoder top, runs over and down into the decoder's Multi-head Attention block from the left.
insights.avoid: The unlabeled small trapezoid stack beside the encoder is ambiguous without the caption.

arrangement.units: two blue dashed rounded frames, Encoder and Decoder, titled at the top inside
arrangement.inputs_as: cell strips of sequence tokens with math labels
arrangement.shared: encoder feature map feeds the decoder cross-attention
